  content = '## Quantumania

Quantumania was an ambitious but divisive film that attempted to launch Kang the Conqueror as the MCU''s next Thanos-level threat. Jonathan Majors delivered a commanding performance, but the film''s heavy CGI, Quantum Realm setting, and tonal inconsistency drew criticism. It marked the first MCU film to receive a Rotten score on RT.

## The Legacy

- **Kang the Conqueror** — Jonathan Majors'' intimidating villain was meant to anchor the Multiverse Saga
- **M.O.D.O.K.** — The classic Marvel villain made his live-action debut (controversially redesigned)
- **Cassie Lang** — Kathryn Newton took over the role, setting up Young Avengers
- **Box Office Disappointment** — $476M worldwide was well below expectations for a saga launcher
- **MCU Fatigue Debate** — The film became a flashpoint for discussions about MCU quality decline

## Fun Facts

- Jonathan Majors'' Kang was meant to be the MCU''s next multi-film villain before his departure
- Corey Stoll returned as M.O.D.O.K. after playing Yellowjacket in the first Ant-Man
- Bill Murray''s cameo as Lord Krylar was his first MCU appearance
- The Quantum Realm was almost entirely CGI, with minimal practical sets
- The film''s 46% RT score made it the lowest-rated MCU film at the time

## Viewing Context

Quantumania follows **Ant-Man and the Wasp** (2018) and connects to the wider Multiverse Saga through Kang. Janet van Dyne''s Quantum Realm history from the previous films is important context. The post-credits scene introduces the Council of Kangs, though this storyline was later restructured.',
